get.description:
Which optional parts of the app this deployment offers.

Public, and never cached (utils/caching.py skips it): the value comes from
the deployment's settings, and a browser holding the old answer for an
hour after the pods restart would hide or show the wrong links.

Readiness: 503 until the startup cache warmup (utils/warmup.py) has
rendered the hot URL space, so deploys don't expose a cold pod.

Who is signed in, if anyone.

200 with a null user when nobody is, rather than 401: the SPA asks on
every page load, and an anonymous visitor is not an error.

post.description: Mail a sign-in code (and a link that does the same) to an address.
Finish a mail sign-in, with the typed code or the mailed link.
Sign out. Idempotent, so a stale cookie is not an error.

schema.title: Response List Identities Auth Identities Get

delete.description:
Unlink a provider.

Not the last one, it would lock the account. And not ``email``: the
account is found by its address, so whoever proves the address gets in
whatever this table says, and removing the row would only pretend
otherwise.

get.description: Send the browser to GitHub, to sign in or to link an account.

Come back from GitHub: sign the person in, or link the account.

Always a redirect into the SPA, with ``?error=<slug>`` when something went
wrong: the browser lands here by navigation and cannot render JSON.

post.description:
Re-validate a contribution archive and open a pull request on the data
repository. Errors block; warnings pass and are listed in the PR body.

get.description:
Open contribution pull requests on the data repository, for the review
queue. Returns ``configured: false`` (not an error) on deployments without
the GitHub App.

put.description:
Replace an open submission's batch with a new commit on its own branch.
The pull request updates and its checks rerun; no second review is opened.

Answers 403 when the submission was made from another account, and 409
when the branch moved since the editor loaded it: reload and make the
changes again.

get.description:
Everything the review screen needs about one submission, reconstructed
from the pull request at its current head commit.

Re-run server-side validation on the reconstructed batch, producing the
same response shape as ``/validate``. Issue rows index into the detail
endpoint's ``experiments`` list (row N = experiments[N-1]).

The submission's discussion, oldest first, with the pull request body as
the opening entry (it is the submission summary the contributor wrote).

Read-only: replying, requesting changes and approving still happen on
GitHub until per-user auth (#247) and curator roles (#248) land.

Raw text of one file added by the submission (time-series preview).
Only paths the PR actually adds inside the type's layout are served.
Get user count using Google Analytics Data API.

schema.title: Response Get Users Analytics Users Get
